item.title: `Agent Factory`: agents and humans, one crew
item.description: More autonomy and better collaboration, starting from a plain GitHub issue: one label opens an isolated workspace where agents and humans take turns until a pull request comes out reviewed, secured and traceable. Episode one: the problem, and the solution from above.
